versions.changelog: Document optional reciprocal integration with @linzi007/zhizhi-math-coach. Accept selected questions, optional diagnosis, scope and language preferences; return worksheet artifacts, source mappings and review status to the coach. Keep standalone generation independent and avoid recursive handoffs or treating generated answers as student evidence.

Initial standalone worksheet skill: create printable student papers and separate answer keys from a full-paper photo/PDF or a question list. Preserve the direct full-paper workflow and support variants or typesetting from selected questions, with optional diagnostic context. English instructions with English/Chinese output-language selection and PDF preview checks. Reviewed Chinese generation examples; no independent blind test or proven learner-outcome claim.
